recipe.title: Roast pumpkin salad
recipe.notes: This recipe comes from Amy's mum.

i.n: garlic, separated into cloves but not peeled
quartered, with root end on to hold onion together

method.s: Drizzle with olive oil then roast together for 45 minutes: pumpkin, garlic cloves and onion quarters.
Combine dressing ingredients and drizzle over warm salad just before serving.
